sources.label: Mini Games
sources.author: Mini Games
patch_list: Bypasses in-game force update check, treating app always as up-to-date.
Patches libappJni.so so that CheckPackageName and CheckApkSign always return 1 (success).
Bypasses Google Play Integrity / PairIP license check.
Removes baseline.prof to prevent ART installation checksum mismatch warnings.
Completely disables AppsFlyer, Bugly, OnlineConfig and annoying Google Play Games network toasts.
Sets extractNativeLibs and debuggable to true, and removes PairIP LicenseActivity if present.
Bypasses Google Play billing and immediately grants purchased diamonds/packs.
Makes rewarded videos always ready and immediately grants rewards without playing ads.
Automatically backs up and restores save data from Android/media directory across installs.
